source_register.author: Judy Leung / The Woks of Life
observations: Mid-cook photo displays individually curved beans, a range of wrinkle intensity, small uneven tan/dark contact scorch marks, with green areas still apparent.

Recipe explicitly shallow-fries the beans until lightly scorched, removes them, cooks minced pork, and combines with reduced seasonings, not a thick pooled sauce.
source_register.cook_method: Shallow-fry in two batches to wrinkle and spot-scorch; drain, aromatics and minced pork; high-heat final reduction.

source_register.author: Maggie Zhu / Omnivore's Cookbook
observations: Six-step wok collage has greener pods and visible mixed small caramelized areas even at 'just tender' stage, not every bean uniformly shrivelled.
Finished black-plate photo has separate irregular pork crumbles, red dried chilies and patchy bean-skin reflections; still has localized shine.
Written instructions use pan sear, flip until withered/scorched areas develop, then add pork, aromatics and absorb sauce; distinct materials do not share identical reflection patterns.
source_register.cook_method: Pan sear over medium-high heat until blistered and softening; stir-fry with pork and spices.

dimensions.finding: Keep recognizable kidney/string bean pods; tapered ends, nonuniform bends and segments. Avoid substituting garlic shoots or broad pepper pieces.
Contraction and slight wilt/wrinkling varies across pods and within each pod. Some segments remain fuller green while others have folded skin.
Small spatially uneven scorch or toasted spots on different surfaces, not every bean ringed in the same brown/black stripe.
Thin reflective oil/sauce film on some bean ridges may remain, with local glints differing by orientation and cooking route. Do NOT default to matte/no shine.
For the 2017 Woks version, final moisture is reduced to coat the beans, with no thick sauce pool. Not a universal prohibition across every restaurant variant.
Minced pork appears as irregular separate browned crumb texture, not as a uniform green-bean glaze or perfect model chunks.
Dry-wok vs shallow frying or additional seasonings can shift shine, wrinkle and local char. A single static 'correctness' target is not fully justified without cooking context.

observed_cooking_material_model.mechanistic_caveat: Moisture loss, localized hot surface contact and fat-coating provide physically plausible explanations but were not laboratory-measured. No universal highlight percentage, scorch count, precise reflectance BRDF or generated-photo authenticity score is asserted.
